title: [DSV4] perf: Make FP8 quant output tensor contiguous
body: ## Motivation This PR is an alternative way to achieve https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/27680. Deep gemm FP8 einsum silently falls back to an unoptimized path if the input tensor is not contiguous. We can make the `per_token_group_quant_8bit_v2` to emit the scale layout needed by deep gemm. This also implicitly fixes https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/29038. The previous DSV4 `wo_a` FP8 DeepGEMM path flattened `o: [T, G, D]` into `[T * G, D]` and then viewed the scales back as `[T, G, -1]`. On the SM100 FP8 einsum path, scales are consumed as per-group slabs, so flattening across `T * G` can associate a token's FP8 codes with another group's scale. This PR quantizes `o` as `[T, G, D]` and emits the scale tensor in DeepGEMM's expected outer/group-major layout, preserving the `scale[t, g]` to `o[t, g, :]` association.

## Motivation


Prefill CP today **replicates** at-rest KV storage: every CP rank allgathers the full chunk's K/V and writes all of it into its own pool, so a CP group of size N stores each cached page N times — group-aggregate *unique* cache capacity stays at 1×. ## What
Pack the three split `causal_conv1d_fn` calls (q / k / v) on the KDA extend path into a single packed call over the full qkv width.

## Why
Depthwise conv is channel-independent, so one packed call is bit-exact with the three split calls (verified on GPU, incl. in-place `conv_states` updates, with and without bias) and mirrors the decode path. Drops two kernel launches and two allocations per layer per extend pass.

## Verification
- `py_compile` + `pre-commit` pass.
- Bit-exact optimization (depthwise conv channel independence); the packed call mathematically equals the three split calls and mirrors the decode path's packed form.
- e2e (Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B-Instruct, TP2, `--mamba-radix-cache-strategy extra_buffer`): GSM8K 200q warm1=94.50%, warm2=94.50% (identical across warm reruns — bit-exactness holds under radix reuse).
